name: hud
description: One line above the prompt: context fill, rate-limit windows, session cost, prompt-cache countdown, and the buttons handoff, Compact, Clear and Progress; /hud with the same figures as text.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime, minutes
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is assumed to live after a reply. The countdown is an estimate: last reply plus this value.

warnPercent.title: Warn at, percent of a limit
warnPercent.description: Colour a limit amber from this value and show a toast once when it is crossed.

redPercent.title: Red at, percent of a limit
redPercent.description: Show a limit in bold bright red from this value and toast once when it is crossed.

ctxWarnPercent.title: Context amber from, percent
ctxWarnPercent.description: The context figure turns amber from this fill.

ctxRedPercent.title: Context red from, percent
ctxRedPercent.description: The context figure turns red from this fill.
